verdict.rationale: Bento's homepage claims revenue attribution back to the email or flow that preceded a sale, which covers conversions per campaign and automation. The broadcasts API lets you review broadcast history, but nothing documents open, click, or unsubscribe metrics per campaign or per workflow step. Missing for 10: documented per-campaign open/click/unsubscribe reporting, per-automation-step analytics, time-series trends, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
